scope: renderer-neutral pose solvers plus owner-sampled terrestrial movement integration and deterministic grid detours for persistent N3 quadrupeds
ownedProcesses: two-segment quadruped limb pose from a body-local foot contact target
explicit reporting when a requested foot contact lies outside limb reach
fish axial pose derived from flexible-joint angle limits
resolve sampled terrestrial routes against slope and wading depth limits
resolve sampled freshwater routes against minimum water depth
plan deterministic grid detours around slope and wading limits when a direct route is blocked
plan deterministic freshwater grid routes around cells shallower than the caller-supplied swim-depth limit without cutting diagonal corners
apply the accepted terrestrial route position and travel distance to persistent L0 agents
pose and movement output isolated from persistent agent state and metabolic costs
coreMediatedInputs: Core copies Geosphere ground elevation and Hydrosphere surface-water depth into ZoologyCellStateV1; Biosphere samples the read-only observations along a route
scopeLimitations: the integrated N3 movement uses fixed prototype slope and wading thresholds that are not calibrated to any real species
detours use only sampled slope and water fields; there is no body-volume collision or obstacle representation beyond those fields
freshwater routes have no current-vector, submerged-solid, or species-specific swimming-depth observations
aquatic displacement, current response, propulsion, and fish-agent integration remain unimplemented
Z1 anatomy and the N3 generic functional profiles are not linked into one per-individual locomotion profile
validationPending: calibrate movement thresholds and energetic cost against selected animal populations
add body-volume collision and test route-planner robustness across varied terrain before claiming travel around arbitrary obstacles
integrate fish displacement with water current and collision boundaries before claiming aquatic locomotion
